text:
In this rehearsal of 5000 synthetic residents (Storm at the school run), 7881 trips: 6169 on time, 71 late, 1399 could not happen and 79 turned back. It is a rehearsal, not a forecast.

2. Teenagers: 151 of 362 could not make a trip, 14 late.
3. Older residents (65+): 48 of 464 could not make a trip, 18 late.
4. Wheelchair users: 3 of 12 could not make a trip, 0 late.
5. Parents with a stroller: 43 of 217 could not make a trip, 7 late.
6. Households without a car: 156 of 442 could not make a trip, 3 late.
Worth knowing:
• Residents are synthetic: a rehearsal on the township model, not a forecast and not real people.
• This is an indicative scenario, not a forecast. Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.

q: Apa yang berlaku kepada penduduk dalam latihan ribut semasa perjalanan ke sekolah?
text:
Dalam latihan ribut semasa perjalanan ke sekolah, hujan lebat bermula pukul 06:15 dan sungai dimodelkan naik. Daripada 7,881 perjalanan oleh 5,000 penduduk sintetik, 6,169 tepat pada masa, 71 lewat, 1,399 dibatalkan, 79 berpatah balik, dan 163 tiada data. Tiada yang terkandas. Di sekolah, 979 daripada 1,373 murid tiba tepat pada masa, 261 perjalanan dibatalkan, 81 berpatah balik.
Perlu diketahui:
• Ini ialah latihan dengan penduduk sintetik, bukan ramalan dan bukan orang sebenar.
• Tahap sungai ialah senario penunjuk (+1 m hingga +3 m), bukan ramalan. Ikut garis panduan rasmi MBSA, JPS dan NADMA.

q: What happens to residents in the storm rehearsal?
text:
In the storm rehearsal (a rehearsal of synthetic residents, not a forecast), the river rose to +3 m during the school run. Of 7,881 trips, 6,169 were on time, 71 late, 1,399 cancelled, 79 turned back, and 163 had a data gap. No residents were stranded. Children, teenagers, households without a car and parents with strollers had the most cancelled or unmade trips. Of 1,373 pupils, 979 were on time and 261 were cancelled.
Worth knowing:
• Indicative rehearsal with synthetic residents, not a forecast and not real people.
• Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.
• 163 trips had no mapped connection, which is a data gap rather than a confirmed outcome.

q: Which change would help most residents in the storm rehearsal?
text:
In the storm rehearsal, the change that would help most is raising the flooded stretch on Jalan Sungai Buloh (about 931 m) so it never floods. This is a what-if simulation on synthetic residents, not a plan or a forecast: 823 residents would be better off and none worse off, across 1645 trips. Of these, 12 wheelchair users (2 better off) and 442 households without a car (80 better off) were counted in the groups.
Worth knowing:
• Imagined change on a rehearsal of synthetic residents: not a plan, not a promise and not a forecast. The real township is unchanged.
• Indicative scenario, not a forecast.

q: In the storm rehearsal, what happens to my trip from Car Park B to SK Denai Alam by car leaving at 7:30?
text:
In the storm rehearsal, a 7:30 drive from Lakeside Mall Car Park B to SK Denai Alam found no way through. The flooded streets cut it were an unnamed street and the street on Persiaran Alstonia. The same drive takes about 8 minutes normally. This is a rehearsal of synthetic residents, not a forecast.
1. In the rehearsal, leaving at 06:30 or 06:40 got through in about 8 minutes.
2. Leaving between 06:50 and 12:20 had no way through, including 07:30.
3. Leaving from 12:30 got through again in about 8 minutes.
Worth knowing:
• Indicative scenario, not a forecast: the river rises to River +3 m at 07:25 in the rehearsal, falls back to River +2 m at 10:00 and River +1 m at 11:00, and is clear by 12:30.
• Rehearsal of synthetic residents, not real people; follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.
